milestones.title: A first planting
milestones.description: You sowed the first wildflowers in the forgotten garden.
milestones.hint: Open Plants and sow wildflower seeds in a sunny, open spot.

milestones.title: Signs of growth
milestones.description: Something you planted has begun to grow.
milestones.hint: Your seeds are settling in. Growth continues while you explore.

milestones.title: Clearing the way
milestones.description: You cleared some of the overgrowth.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and clear overgrown tiles. You'll find twigs and leaf litter underneath.

milestones.title: Gathering
milestones.description: You gathered natural materials from around the garden. You can now craft a natural shelter.
milestones.hint: Tap materials lying in the garden to gather them, or use Gather all.

milestones.title: A first visitor
milestones.description: A butterfly found its way to your flowers.
milestones.hint: Butterflies visit flowering plants. Give your wildflowers time to bloom.

milestones.title: A place to shelter
milestones.description: You built the garden's first natural shelter.
milestones.hint: Build a natural shelter from twigs, bark and leaf litter, ideally in a shaded corner.

milestones.title: First residents
milestones.description: Wildlife has moved into your shelter. You can now improve it.
milestones.hint: Shelters in shade, with plant cover nearby, attract residents sooner.

milestones.title: A garden restored
milestones.description: Three kinds of plant have grown to maturity. The forgotten garden is alive again.
milestones.hint: Grow three different kinds of plant to maturity.

completion.title: The forgotten garden is alive again
body: Flowers draw butterflies along the old paths, and small creatures shelter beneath the pines.
With a creak, the old gate in the north wall swings open. Beyond it, bamboo rustles in the wind: the Bamboo Grove is waiting.

completion.title: The grove breathes again
body: Light falls through the bamboo onto soft forest grass, and small creatures have found homes among the canes.
Somewhere beyond the grove, water is moving. The old wetland will be the next part of your sanctuary to wake.

milestones.title: Into the grove
milestones.description: You stepped through the gate and looked around the bamboo grove.
milestones.hint: Step through the open gate and take a look around the grove: tap anywhere inside it.

milestones.title: A way forward
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the grove are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the grove.

milestones.title: Bamboo and understory
milestones.description: Young bamboo and shade plants are growing in the grove.
milestones.hint: Plant bamboo shoots and a couple of forest grasses or hostas in the grove.

milestones.title: Gathering canes
milestones.description: You harvested bamboo canes. Shelters can now grow in new directions.
milestones.hint: Tap a mature bamboo clump and harvest its canes.

milestones.title: A specialised refuge
milestones.description: You turned an improved shelter into a specialised home.
milestones.hint: Grow a shelter into a Mossy log lodge, then choose a direction for it.

milestones.title: A new arrival
milestones.description: A creature new to your sanctuary found its way to the grove.
milestones.hint: White-eyes visit established bamboo, and each specialised shelter draws its own residents.

milestones.title: The grove restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the grove.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

optional.title: A tree comes of age
optional.description: Your Japanese maple is fully grown. Its leaves and sap open new things to make.
optional.hint: A maple takes a few hours to mature; it keeps growing while you are away.

completion.title: The pond comes alive
body: Lilies float on clear water, reeds sway along the margin, and frogs call from the shallows.
Up the bank, beyond a low stone gate, a quiet garden of stone and moss waits to be found.

milestones.title: To the water
milestones.description: You stepped through the gate and looked around the old pond.
milestones.hint: Step through the grove’s north gate and take a look around the pond.

milestones.title: A plan for the pond
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the pond are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the pond.

milestones.title: Planting by depth
milestones.description: Plants are growing in the water and along its edge.
milestones.hint: Plant lilies or hornwort out in the water, and reeds on the margin.

milestones.title: Dragonflies return
milestones.description: A dragonfly found a perch among the reeds.
milestones.hint: Dragonflies come once two reeds or rushes are fully grown.

milestones.title: Gathering reeds
milestones.description: You gathered reed stems. You can now build a frog shelter.
milestones.hint: Mature reeds shed stems; gather six.

milestones.title: A home by the water
milestones.description: You built a frog shelter by the pond.
milestones.hint: Build a frog shelter on damp ground beside the water.

milestones.title: Frogs arrive
milestones.description: A tree frog has come to the pond.
milestones.hint: Frogs come to a frog shelter once dragonflies or pond skaters are about.

milestones.title: The pond restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the pond.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: Stillness and life
body: Raked gravel, warm stones and soft lichen: the stone garden is calm again, and full of small lives in its crevices.
Through a mossy gate to the east, a damp hollow of ferns and fallen wood waits.

milestones.title: Among the stones
milestones.description: You looked around the old stone garden.
milestones.hint: Go through the pond’s north gate and take a look around the stone garden.

milestones.title: A quiet plan
milestones.description: The plans for rebuilding the stone garden are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of rebuilding the stone garden.

milestones.title: Plants for dry ground
milestones.description: Thyme, fescue or lichen are growing among the stones.
milestones.hint: Plant thyme or fescue in sunny, dry spots, or lichen on gravel beside a stone.

milestones.title: Gathering stones
milestones.description: You gathered river stones. You can now build a rock pile and set stones.
milestones.hint: Clear the stone garden’s overgrowth to find river stones.

milestones.title: Warm stones
milestones.description: You built a rock pile in the sun.
milestones.hint: Build a rock pile on sunny, dry ground.

milestones.title: Small lives
milestones.description: Ants or spiders have made the stone garden their home.
milestones.hint: Ants nest in rock piles; jumping spiders bask on warm stones and thyme.

milestones.title: A lizard basks
milestones.description: A grass lizard has come to bask on the warm stones.
milestones.hint: Improve a rock pile into a sun-warmed cairn; lizards follow the small life there.

milestones.title: The stone garden restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to rebuilding the stone garden.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: The woodland floor
body: Ferns unfurl over soft logs, fungi return old wood to the soil, and the hollow’s leaf litter is alive with small workers.
East of the hollow, the trees open onto a sunlit meadow.

milestones.title: Into the hollow
milestones.description: You looked around the damp, shaded hollow.
milestones.hint: Go through the stone garden’s east gate and take a look around the hollow.

milestones.title: A plan for the hollow
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the woodland floor are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the hollow.

milestones.title: Ferns in the shade
milestones.description: Royal ferns and wood sorrel are growing in the hollow.
milestones.hint: Plant royal ferns or wood sorrel in the deep shade.

milestones.title: Gathering deadwood
milestones.description: You gathered deadwood. You can now build a leaf-litter bed and log stacks.
milestones.hint: Clear the hollow’s overgrowth to find fallen wood.

milestones.title: A compost heap
milestones.description: You built a leaf-litter bed.
milestones.hint: Build a leaf-litter bed in the shade, then fill it with leaf litter.

milestones.title: Making leaf mould
milestones.description: Your leaf-litter bed made rich leaf mould.
milestones.hint: Fill the leaf-litter bed with leaf litter; it makes leaf mould while it is full.

milestones.title: Decomposers at work
milestones.description: Woodlice or millipedes have moved into the leaf bed.
milestones.hint: Woodlice and millipedes live in a leaf-litter bed in damp shade.

milestones.title: A toad appears
milestones.description: A toad has found the deep leaf litter.
milestones.hint: Improve the leaf-litter bed into a deep leaf bed; toads follow the woodlice and millipedes.

milestones.title: The hollow restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the woodland floor.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: A meadow in bloom
body: Daisies, clover, asters and bellflowers sway in the long grass, and the air hums with many kinds of visitor.
To the south, past a gate by the meadow’s edge, you can hear running water.

milestones.title: Into the meadow
milestones.description: You looked around the open meadow.
milestones.hint: Go through the hollow’s east gate and take a look around the meadow.

milestones.title: A plan for the meadow
milestones.description: The plans for sowing the meadow are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of sowing the meadow.

milestones.title: Sowing the meadow
milestones.description: Meadow flowers are growing in the sun.
milestones.hint: Sow three meadow flowers: clover, daisies, asters or bellflowers.

milestones.title: Many kinds
milestones.description: Four different species are growing in the meadow.
milestones.hint: Variety matters here: grow four different species in the meadow.

milestones.title: Hoverflies
milestones.description: Hoverflies came to the meadow’s mix of flowers.
milestones.hint: Hoverflies come where at least two kinds of flower are in bloom.

milestones.title: Gathering grass
milestones.description: You gathered grass stems. You can now build a bee bank.
milestones.hint: Grow tall meadow grass and gather five of its stems.

milestones.title: A bank for bees
milestones.description: You built a bee bank in the sun.
milestones.hint: Build a bee bank on sunny, dry ground.

milestones.title: A meadow visitor
milestones.description: A meadow specialist found its way here.
milestones.hint: Mining bees nest in a bee bank, grasshoppers sing from long grass, and a hawk-moth loves variety.

milestones.title: The meadow sown
milestones.description: You completed one approach to sowing the meadow.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: The stream sings again
body: Water runs clear between planted banks, demoiselles flicker over the iris, and a wagtail bobs on the stones.
Across a small arched gate to the west, blossom drifts over an old court.

milestones.title: By the stream
milestones.description: You looked around the stream garden.
milestones.hint: Go through the meadow’s south gate and take a look along the stream.

milestones.title: A plan for the stream
milestones.description: The plans for reconnecting the stream are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of reconnecting the stream.

milestones.title: Planted banks
milestones.description: Plants are growing right beside the stream.
milestones.hint: Plant iris, sedge or marsh fern right beside the running water.

milestones.title: Demoiselles
milestones.description: A banded demoiselle came to rest by the stream.
milestones.hint: Demoiselles rest on mature iris and sedge beside the water.

milestones.title: Gathering pebbles
milestones.description: You gathered pebbles. You can now set resting stones.
milestones.hint: Clear the stream’s overgrown banks to find pebbles.

milestones.title: A crossing
milestones.description: Stones lie in and across the stream.
milestones.hint: Place stepping stones or resting stones in the stream: three in all.

milestones.title: A wagtail
milestones.description: A grey wagtail came to bob on the stones.
milestones.hint: Wagtails stand on stones in the stream once mayflies or demoiselles are about.

milestones.title: The stream reconnected
milestones.description: You completed one approach to reconnecting the stream.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: Blossom and song
body: Cherry blossom drifts across the court, the border flowers from low to high, and birds come for the fruit.
South of the court, through a timber gate, the canopy of a great old tree shades the way.

milestones.title: Into the court
milestones.description: You looked around the old blossom court.
milestones.hint: Go through the stream’s west gate and take a look around the court.

milestones.title: A plan for the court
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the court are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the court.

milestones.title: Shrubs planted
milestones.description: Flowering shrubs are growing in the border.
milestones.hint: Plant three flowering shrubs: camellia, azalea, hydrangea or quince.

milestones.title: A blossom tree
milestones.description: A young flowering cherry is growing in the court.
milestones.hint: Plant a flowering cherry in a sunny spot.

milestones.title: A layered border
milestones.description: Four different species grow in the court.
milestones.hint: Grow four different species in the court, from low to tall.

milestones.title: First fruit
milestones.description: You gathered quince fruit. You can now build a fruit table.
milestones.hint: Flowering quince fruits once it flowers; gather three.

milestones.title: A table for birds
milestones.description: You built a fruit table.
milestones.hint: Build a fruit table and set quince out on it.

milestones.title: A bulbul
milestones.description: A brown-eared bulbul came for the fruit.
milestones.hint: Fill the fruit table with quince; bulbuls come while it holds fruit.

milestones.title: The court restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the court.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: Under the old oak
body: Beneath the ancient oak, holly and ivy fill the understory, tits nest in the boxes, and something small stirs at dusk.
East of the canopy, the ground grows soft and wet: a marsh of reeds is waiting.

milestones.title: Under the canopy
milestones.description: You looked around beneath the ancient oak.
milestones.hint: Go through the court’s south gate and take a look under the old oak.

milestones.title: A plan for the tree
milestones.description: The plans for protecting the old tree are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of protecting the old tree.

milestones.title: The understory
milestones.description: Holly, ivy or anemones grow beneath the canopy.
milestones.hint: Plant three understory plants in the oak’s shade: holly, ivy or wood anemone.

milestones.title: Gathering acorns
milestones.description: You gathered acorns. You can now build a nest box.
milestones.hint: The ancient oak drops acorns; gather four.

milestones.title: A nest box
milestones.description: You put up a nest box.
milestones.hint: Build a nest box in the shade, near cover.

milestones.title: A tit nests
milestones.description: A varied tit moved into the nest box.
milestones.hint: Varied tits use a nest box in shade with cover nearby.

milestones.title: Night and day
milestones.description: A dormouse or a bat has found a home under the canopy.
milestones.hint: Turn a used nest box into a dormouse box or a bat box.

milestones.title: The tree protected
milestones.description: You completed one approach to protecting the old tree.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: A living marsh
body: Reed beds rustle around open pools, marigolds glow at the edges, and the marsh rings with birdsong.
South of the marsh, a garden of many trees waits for the turning of the seasons.

milestones.title: Into the marsh
milestones.description: You looked around the wet, silted marsh.
milestones.hint: Go through the canopy’s east gate and take a look around the marsh.

milestones.title: A plan for the marsh
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the marsh are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the marsh.

milestones.title: Marsh planting
milestones.description: Cattails, marigolds or frogbit are growing in the marsh.
milestones.hint: Plant cattails or marigolds in the mud, and frogbit on the open water.

milestones.title: Gathering fluff
milestones.description: You gathered cattail fluff. You can now lay a boardwalk.
milestones.hint: Ripe cattails shed fluff; gather four.

milestones.title: A boardwalk
milestones.description: A boardwalk crosses the marsh.
milestones.hint: Lay two boardwalk sections over the water or mud.

milestones.title: Reed song
milestones.description: A reed warbler sang from the reed beds.
milestones.hint: Reed warblers come to four or more reeds or cattails once water insects are about.

milestones.title: A moorhen
milestones.description: A moorhen came to walk among the floating leaves.
milestones.hint: Moorhens come where frogbit or lilies float on the pools.

milestones.title: The marsh restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the marsh.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: A garden for every season
body: Ume blossom in late winter, fruit in autumn, evergreens through the cold: the garden is lovely in every season.
West of the garden, through an ornamental gateway, lies the Noble Garden.

milestones.title: The turning year
milestones.description: You stepped into the Four Seasons Garden. From now on the sanctuary follows the seasons of your own calendar.
milestones.hint: Go through the marsh’s south gate and take a look around.

milestones.title: A plan for the year
milestones.description: The plans for the garden for every season are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the plans for the garden for every season.

milestones.title: Seasonal planting
milestones.description: Plants for different seasons are growing here.
milestones.hint: Plant ume, beautyberry, mondo grass or snowdrops: three in all.

milestones.title: Something for every season
milestones.description: Four different species grow in the garden.
milestones.hint: Grow four different species, so something is at its best in every season.

milestones.title: Ready for every season
milestones.description: Something in the garden is at its best in every season of the year.
milestones.hint: Ume and snowdrops for winter, ume for spring, beautyberry for summer flowers and autumn fruit, and mondo grass to stay green through the cold.

milestones.title: A seasonal visitor
milestones.description: A visitor came that only appears at its time of year.
milestones.hint: Brimstones come in spring and summer; bullfinches and ladybirds come in autumn and winter.

milestones.title: A garden for every season
milestones.description: You completed one approach to the garden for every season.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: The Noble Garden
body: Lotus flowers above clear water, the bridge spans the pond again, and blossom frames the pavilion. The finest garden of the sanctuary is restored.
In the west wall, the old gate swings open onto the Forgotten Garden where it all began. The sanctuary is whole, and it will keep growing.

milestones.title: The Noble Garden
milestones.description: You stepped into the Noble Garden.
milestones.hint: Go through the Four Seasons Garden’s west gate and take a look around.

milestones.title: A noble plan
milestones.description: The plans for restoring the Noble Garden are laid out in Restore.
milestones.hint: Open Restore to see the ways of restoring the Noble Garden.

milestones.title: Lotus and blossom
milestones.description: Lotus and weeping cherries are growing in the Noble Garden.
milestones.hint: Plant lotus in the pond and weeping cherries beside it: three in all.

milestones.title: Timber and stone
milestones.description: You gathered fine timber. You can now build the bridge, pavilion and lanterns.
milestones.hint: Clear the Noble Garden’s overgrowth for old timber, or make it from fallen branches and bark.

milestones.title: A bridge
milestones.description: A stone bridge spans the water again.
milestones.hint: Build a stone bridge over the water.

milestones.title: A composed garden
milestones.description: A pavilion, lanterns or benches complete the view.
milestones.hint: Build a pavilion, lanterns or stone benches: two in all.

milestones.title: The Noble Garden restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the Noble Garden.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

optional.title: A golden visitor
optional.description: The golden dragonfly came to the Noble Garden’s pond.
optional.hint: A rare dragonfly visits when lotus flowers on the pond and other dragonflies are about.
